description: Flood Risk is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.london.gov.uk. The Flood Zones show the probability of river and sea flooding, ignoring the presence of defences. There are four zones, 1, 2, 3a and 3b, that reflect the annual probability of flooding happening. Coverage: GB. Its keywords include planningconstraintsmap, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
